settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public host name Open WebUI is published on. It must resolve to this server.
settings.ollama_base_url_helper: URL of your external Ollama instance (e.g. running on Proxmox). Separate several with ';'. Leave empty to add connections later inside the UI.
settings.webui_name_helper: Display name shown in the chat interface (WEBUI_NAME).
settings.default_user_role_helper: Role assigned to newly registered or first-login LDAP users. 'Pending approval' requires an admin to approve them before they can log in.
settings.ldap_mail_attribute_helper: Open WebUI requires every user to have an e-mail. Defaults to mail; on Active Directory where mail is empty, use userPrincipalName.
settings.timezone_helper: TZ database name for scheduling and log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
settings.web_url_desc: Open the chat interface in the browser at {url}
settings.models_hint_desc: The first account that logs in becomes the administrator. Set the Ollama base URL above to your external instance, then pick a model in the chat interface. Models are pulled and run on the external Ollama host, not on this server.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.

ldap_login.no_domains: This cluster has no user domain yet. Add one in Domains and users, or enter an LDAP server.
ldap_login.group_helper: Only members of this group may log in (nested groups count). Empty: every user of the domain.
ldap_login.group_custom_helper: Group name or DN; only its members may log in. Empty: every user found under the base DN.
ldap_login.custom_intro: Only needed for a directory that is not a user domain of this cluster. NS8 can also add an external AD/LDAP as a user domain (Domains and users): then it shows up above and no credentials are stored here.
ldap_login.url_helper: ldaps://host:636 (Open WebUI does not support StartTLS)
ldap_login.tls_verify_off: The certificate is not checked: someone in the network path could read the passwords. Only for tests or a trusted network.
ldap_login.bind_password_helper: Password of the service account; stored outside the module environment.
ldap_login.secret_is_set: A password is stored — leave blank to keep it.
ldap_login.ldap_domain_unknown: This user domain does not exist in the cluster
ldap_login.start_tls_with_ldaps: StartTLS is only for ldap:// URLs
ldap_login.start_tls_unsupported: Open WebUI does not support StartTLS; use an ldaps:// URL instead
